quizName: Sign Test Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign shape and color mean?
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs only mark no passing zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Turn right after making a complete stop.

questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It means drivers cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that your road meets a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or guard rail.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs mark sharp curves in the direction shown by the arrow. You may see several of these signs along a curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Circular signs mean a railroad crossing is ahead. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Pedestrians walking along the road ahead.
Be alert for construction workers on the road.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that pedestrians cross ahead. Slow down and watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign means you cannot park in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow and black warning sign tells you a lane is ending. Prepare to merge safely with other traffic.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign mean?

options.text: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
Helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
Tells you about traffic laws and regulations.
Tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black symbols on yellow backgrounds. They alert you to road conditions and hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign means a traffic signal is coming. Be ready to stop for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
Two lanes of traffic moving in opposite directions are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead has a low clearance.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has low clearance. Do not drive under it if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet, 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does the posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed at which you must travel to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe driving speed under all road conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe driving speed under ideal road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum legal speed for that road. You may need to drive slower than the limit. When conditions are bad, always slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if an emergency vehicle is approaching.
Look both ways as you cross the intersection.
Always come to a full stop at the intersection.
Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and be prepared to stop if necessary.
questions.explanation: Slow down as you approach a yield sign. Be ready to stop and let other vehicles and pedestrians go first. Stop completely if traffic requires it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road curves and winds ahead. Slow down and adjust your speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Drive carefully through the work zone.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic turning left on the green light must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells drivers turning left on green that they do not have the right-of-way. Wait for oncoming traffic to clear before turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road turns sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must do. U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead is closed to traffic.
The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highway ahead is undergoing maintenance.
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers of construction or maintenance work ahead. This sign tells you to slow down and drive with extra caution near the work area.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that another road will join from the right at an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
You may proceed if the way is clear.
Come to a complete stop before proceeding.

questions.correctAnswerText: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: If you see this sign, you are going the wrong way on a one-way street. This puts you at risk of a head-on crash. Turn around carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is coming. Be alert for traffic from other directions.

questions.question: At an intersection with a yield sign, what should you do?

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Yield just to the traffic on the right.
Yield just to the traffic on the left.
Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield the right-of-way to other traffic.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let other vehicles go before you enter the intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Divided highway begins. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Merge. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
Winding road ahead. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves right. Slow down to the safe speed indicated.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road curves to the right ahead. Reduce your speed to the posted safe speed (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the overpass ahead has limited height clearance. Do not proceed if your vehicle is taller than the height shown on the sign (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow diamonds that alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a steep hill is coming. Be ready to adjust your speed to stay safe.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and vehicles with the minimum number of passengers shown on the sign may use this lane.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When riding in a group, the lead rider uses hand signals to communicate. When the lead rider extends their left arm straight out with palm up, then swings the arm upward, it tells other riders to increase their speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Trucks are allowed on the narrow bridge ahead.
The bridge ahead is one-way traffic only.
The bridge ahead fits only one car at a time.
The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.

questions.correctAnswerText: The bridge ahead may be too narrow to pass a truck.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers about hazards ahead. It warns that an upcoming bridge may be too narrow to safely pass a truck, so you should be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of or along with turn signals. When the left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, it signals a right turn or lane change to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers to yield to oncoming traffic when turning left on a green light. You can complete the turn when it is safe.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and check for pedestrians and cross traffic.
questions.explanation: Any eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and look for pedestrians and cross traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before proceeding.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that deer cross the roadway in this area. Slow down, stay alert, and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop only if other cars are approaching

questions.explanation: This sign shows where bicycles cross or ride beside the road. Drive carefully in this area because bicycles regularly use this path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road curves only to the right.
The road turns sharply to the right.
The road curves to the right and then to the left.
The road curves to the left and then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves to the right and then to the left.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts drivers about hazards. It warns that the road ahead curves right, then left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means that action is prohibited. U-turns are not permitted where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This is a __________ sign.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign is a yield sign. Slow down and check for traffic. Let pedestrians and other vehicles cross first. Only stop if you need to.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a rule you must follow. It means you cannot turn left here.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign tells you which direction traffic moves on this street. You must drive in the direction shown.

questions.question: When riding in a group, what does it mean when the lead rider raises their left arm and extends their index finger?

options.text: The group will pull off at the next exit.

questions.explanation: This hand signal tells riders to form a single line. It is an important way riders communicate with each other.

questions.question: When an operator's left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means the operator:
questions.explanation: This hand signal means the operator is turning left or changing lanes to the left. Operators use hand signals when they do not have turn signals.

questions.question: This sign is used to warn drivers about:

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road curves to the right ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell you to stop completely. You must yield to other traffic. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, whether there's a stop sign or not.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always sound your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children crossing the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: Watch for children near schools. You must let pedestrians cross safely. Be alert at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs prepare you for hazards ahead. This sign tells you a sharp turn is coming. Reduce your speed.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
The road ahead winds a series of turns or curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: When pavement is wet, reduce your speed.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is slippery when wet. Slow down in wet conditions. Do not brake or turn suddenly. Stay farther away from other vehicles.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign warns you about a steep downhill section. Slow down to protect your brakes and avoid accidents.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is reserved only for left turns. You cannot use it to pass other vehicles or for regular traffic flow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign alerts you that the road will curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that a divided highway is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school's parking lot.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that you are approaching a school zone. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that traffic is merging in from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two one-way roadways with a median between them. Stay in the right lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This three-sided sign tells you to slow down at the intersection ahead. Be ready to stop and let other drivers or pedestrians go first. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead has many curves and turns.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing down, it means they plan to slow down or stop.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Look for a train station ahead.
Slow down and yield for trains.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and yield for trains.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that railroad tracks are ahead. Always slow down at railroad crossings. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for trains to pass before crossing the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
Lane reduction; the left lane ends soon.

questions.correctAnswerText: Lane reduction; the right lane ends soon.
questions.explanation: This sign means the right lane is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that right turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in the lane must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver and one or more passengers.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking spaces are reserved for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces that are reserved only for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What must you do when you see this sign?

options.text: May pass a slow-moving vehicle if you can do so quickly.
May pass if you know the road ahead.
May pass, but only at night.

questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot pass other vehicles at this location. You must obey this sign.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean when riding in a group?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm straight down with palm facing back, all riders in the group should stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop if cars are approaching you.
Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
Proceed carefully through the intersection, not always stopping.
Stop only for traffic on an intersecting road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop and go when it is safe to do so.
questions.explanation: You must come to a full stop at this sign. Let vehicles and pedestrians pass, then go when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This sign means there is an obstacle ahead. You must drive to the side shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When the lead rider extends their left arm out with palm facing down and swings it down to their side, riders following should slow down.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a traffic signal is coming up at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign alerts you that a side road is ahead. Be aware that traffic may be entering from this side road.

questions.question: What should you be most concerned about when you see this sign?

options.text: Your headlights will be misaligned because one side of your car is higher than the other.
You might damage a tire by drifting onto the shoulder.
You might hydroplane if there is water on the shoulder.
You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You could lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign means the shoulder is lower than the road ahead. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply to get back on the road. This will cause you to lose control.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign tells you a stop sign is coming. Prepare to come to a complete stop.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway ends ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that two-way traffic is ahead.

questions.question: This sign is used to prevent:

options.text: Wrong-way entrances on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Wrong-way entrances on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that traffic on this road moves in one direction only. You must not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming conditions and hazards. This sign alerts you to an upcoming intersection.

questions.question: This sign is a warning that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign indicates that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: This sign means:
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: This road sign means:

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop. Wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals show your intent to turn or stop. When your left arm is extended straight out to the left, it means you plan to turn left or change lanes to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: U-turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may turn right or go straight.
You may turn left or go straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may turn right or go straight.
questions.explanation: From this lane, you can either turn right or continue straight.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and are shaped like diamonds. They warn drivers of upcoming hazards. This sign tells you that the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: When you see this black and yellow sign, it means:

options.text: The road to the right is one-way only.
Detour right due to roadwork ahead.
Slow down. The road ahead turns sharply at an extreme angle.
There is a crossroad to your right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down. The road ahead turns sharply at an extreme angle.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead turns sharply to the right. Slow down before the sharp turn, just as you would at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot drive in your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane ends or the road narrows ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings and are shaped like diamonds. They warn drivers of upcoming hazards. This sign warns that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down and prepare to stop.
Come to a full stop, then go if it is safe.
Proceed carefully through the intersection without always stopping.
Stop only if traffic is on the crossing road.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop, then go if it is safe.
questions.explanation: You must always come to a complete stop at a stop sign. Only proceed when it is safe to do so.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will turn sharply to the right and then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you to stay to the right of the upcoming divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The safest speed for a residential area.
The safest speed for an expressway exit.
The safest speed for an expressway entrance.
The safest speed for a work zone.

questions.correctAnswerText: The safest speed for an expressway exit.
questions.explanation: This advisory speed sign shows the safest speed for a highway exit (in this example, 30 mph).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right and then to the left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Do not drink if you will drive.
The road is slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left at this intersection.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right at this location.

questions.question: From bottom to top, what is the order of traffic light colors?
questions.explanation: From bottom to top, traffic lights are ordered green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: On a freeway, you see a "Merging traffic" sign. What should you do?

options.text: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.

questions.correctAnswerText: Move to another lane, if safe, to let traffic enter.
questions.explanation: Make room for vehicles entering your roadway. If no one is next to you, move over one lane to allow them to merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on the upcoming hill.
Trucks are on the upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep hill or downgrade is coming.

questions.question: When a rider's left arm is bent at the elbow and pointing upward, what does this mean?

options.text: The rider plans to turn left.
The rider is about to stop.
The rider plans to turn right.
The rider is about to slow down.

questions.correctAnswerText: The rider plans to turn right.
questions.explanation: Riders use hand signals instead of turn signals. A left arm bent at the elbow and pointing upward means the rider plans to turn right or change lanes to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you to be careful when the road gets wet and slippery.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows where people cross the road. Watch for pedestrians entering the crosswalk. Slow down and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks a low ground railroad crossing. Railroad tracks cross the road at a steep angle. Low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What is the correct order of traffic lights from top to bottom?
questions.explanation: On a vertical traffic signal, red is always on top and green is always on bottom. On a horizontal signal, red is always on the left and green is always on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign warn drivers about?

options.text: The right lane ends and traffic must move left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The right lane ends and traffic must move left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the right lane will end soon. All traffic in the right lane must move to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Cars in the right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes moving in the same direction will become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers are on or near the road.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on yellow. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns that people may be crossing the road.

questions.question: What must you do if you see this sign above your lane?

options.text: You can stay in your lane or exit the freeway.
You can stay in your lane and continue on the freeway.
You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit the freeway if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means your lane will leave the freeway as a ramp. If you are in this lane, you can change lanes to continue on the freeway, or you must exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road is slippery when wet.
A bump in the road is ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn drivers about hazards ahead. This sign tells you to drive carefully when the road is wet because it may be slippery and harder to control your vehicle.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in this work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for road hazards ahead. This sign warns you that the road has low clearance.

questions.question: What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: Hand signals help riders communicate when riding in groups. This signal means "follow me."

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in this work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a roundabout is coming. Enter the roundabout slowly and let other traffic pass before you go.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down over a lane means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must stop completely and let other traffic go first.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other traffic pass if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other traffic pass if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means yield. You must slow down at the intersection and be ready to stop. Let any vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a T intersection is coming where you may need to turn left or right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes very slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you a flagger is ahead controlling traffic in a construction area.
